ROW.COLUMN: Financial institutions are under increased regulatory pressure to improve their collection and verification of customer information, particularly at account opening. The information collected to support these efforts provides a rich source of data that can be used to support enhanced profiling capabilities. Anticipatory profiling is designed to leverage key parameters that describe anticipated or expected account activity which can be used to detect or prevent fraud. For example, deviations from expected activity for an account could be indicative of identity theft or an account takeover scheme. This scenario monitors transactions involving customer accounts relative to the expected activity for the account, and generates an alert when activity deviates significantly from expected activity.
